claims.text: The primary corpus used is the Japanese-English (Ja-En) ASPEC dataset, with a subset of 500K sentence pairs selected for training.
The WMT dataset is used for English-German (En-De) translation, specifically utilizing news-test2014 as a development set and news-test2015 and news-test2016 as test sets.
